scan_angles: arXiv: cross-sectional momentum + factor momentum + ML

papers_reviewed.title: LLM as a Risk Manager: LLM Semantic Filtering for Lead-Lag Trading in Prediction Markets
papers_reviewed.relevance_notes: Directly applicable to Kalshi H185 infrastructure. Granger causality + LLM veto raises win rate 51.4→54.5%, cuts avg losing trade 649→347. Staged as H334.

papers_reviewed.title: Toward Reliable Evaluation of LLM-Based Financial Multi-Agent Systems: Taxonomy, Coordination Primacy, and Cost Awareness
papers_reviewed.relevance_notes: Coordination Primacy Hypothesis, CBS metric, 5 evaluation failures. Extends multi-agent-llm-trading.md. Staged as wiki update.

papers_reviewed.title: Profit Mirage: Revisiting Information Leakage in LLM-based Financial Agents
papers_reviewed.relevance_notes: 4 information leakage dimensions, FactFin counterfactual defense. Bundled into wiki update (proposal 2). Key implication: H163/H174 2023 events may have training-data leakage.

papers_reviewed.title: Machine Learning Enhanced Multi-Factor Quantitative Trading: A Cross-Sectional Portfolio Optimization Approach with Bias Correction
papers_reviewed.relevance_notes: 213-factor PyTorch engine with bias correction, Sharpe 1.63 OOS — but on Chinese A-shares. Mask-first design principle is transferable. Not staged (China-specific).

papers_reviewed.title: FinPos: A Position-Aware Trading Agent System for Real Financial Markets
papers_reviewed.relevance_notes: Dual decision agents, multi-timescale rewards for position management. Interesting architecture but no US equity benchmark numbers extractable. Not staged.

papers_reviewed.title: Enhancing Post Earnings Announcement Drift Measurement with LLMs
papers_reviewed.relevance_notes: FinBERT achieves 57.6%/58.3% classification accuracy on PEAD detection (positive/negative groups). Press release content as informative as EPS surprise. Could not read full PDF. Worth revisiting when accessible.

papers_reviewed.title: Kalshi AI Trading Bot toolkit
papers_reviewed.relevance_notes: Best reference implementation for Kalshi automated pipeline. RSA auth, SQLite, event-driven loop, Kelly sizing, Streamlit dashboard. Incorporated directly into wiki Phase 1.

papers_reviewed.title: OctagonAI Kalshi Deep Trading Bot CLI
papers_reviewed.relevance_notes: 5-gate risk engine, deep fundamental research per market, CLI interface. Good production reference for risk controls section of pipeline.

summary: Tonight's scan focused on prediction market pipeline automation (for the wiki Phase 1) and multi-agent reliability. Key finding: arXiv:2602.07048 provides a directly actionable extension to the H185 Kalshi infrastructure (H334). The Profit Mirage paper raises a flag on H163/H174 OOS validity for 2023 events. Cross-sectional momentum angle yielded only China-specific results. PEAD paper was a PDF that couldn't be parsed.
